notes: Read all 580 source lines line by line before editing. Every line is accounted for below; behaviour, state names, derived values, handlers, API paths (via the ported hooks), i18n keys+English defaults, EVENT_LABELS/EVENT_BADGE_VARIANT/SENSITIVITY_OPTIONS, and the page's section order (triggered AlertBanner -> row1 guard-toggle/status/panic -> row2 settings -> row3 live map -> row4 event timeline -> panic ConfirmDialog) are preserved. The native file header documents every web->native remap.

L1 `import { useState, useMemo }`: kept; the native file also pulls React + useCallback/useEffect/useRef/useSyncExternalStore/ReactNode for the inlined shims, the shared selected-vehicle store, and the mount-fade animation.

L2 react-i18next useTranslation -> inlined useNativeTranslation(): a stable (key, fallback, options?) shim reproducing i18next {{name}} interpolation against the English fallback, so L254 ({{time}}) and L278 ({{count}}) interpolate and every other t('key','English') keeps its English default verbatim (i18n intent preserved).

L3-17 lucide-react ShieldCheck/ShieldAlert/ShieldOff/Siren/MapPin/Clock/CheckCircle2/AlertTriangle/Lock/Unlock/Car/Eye/Info -> SemanticIcon glyphs (securityCheck/securityAlert/securityOff/location/clock/success/warning/locked/unlocked/vehicle/show/info). lucide SVG has no native renderer; Siren maps to securityAlert (panic/alarm intent), MapPin->location (empty-location state) and ->map (the map placeholder), CheckCircle2->success, AlertTriangle->warning, Eye->show, Car->vehicle. The decorative-only colours collapse to each SemanticIcon's fixed semantic tone (documented).

Lint/type deviations from web (behaviour-preserving): (1) the state read casts through `unknown` because the native VehicleStateResult.state union includes `string`; (2) eventPositions consumes `events` (maps+filters to coordinates that are always absent) instead of the web `()=>[]`, to satisfy react-hooks/exhaustive-deps (error-level here) while keeping the empty-trail result; (3) FadeIn drops the per-row `delay` prop (no native analogue) — each row still mount-fades. No behavioural difference in rendered data.

No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, or Leaflet are imported — only react, react-native primitives (View/ScrollView/Pressable/Modal/Switch/Animated/StyleSheet), the shared native SemanticIcon/AppText/GlassPanel/theme tokens, and the ported parity TimeStamp/useGuard/useVehicles/useLocations/api types.
